Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api

Package persistence.tools

package persistence.tools
Core public API contracts and data types for JPersist Persistence Tools.

This package defines vendor-agnostic interfaces and descriptors for build-time persistence validation, bytecode enhancement, schema verification, and named query parsing:

  • Enhancer – contract for performing build-time bytecode enhancement on compiled JPA entity classes.
  • NamedObjectParser – parses and validates named JPQL queries and stored procedure declarations against the entity metamodel.
  • NamedObjectDescriptor – immutable descriptor representing a parsed named query or stored procedure.
  • NamedObjectType – enumerates the types of parsed persistence objects.
  • SchemaValidator – validates the entity metamodel against a live database schema.
  • PersistenceLinter – marker interface for all persistence linting operations.
